MUTATION-SCAN-RATCHET-1 ratchet pin: per-kernel, per-tier last MEASURED mutation-kill
counts (killed, total) from the nightly Mutation Tier Scan (mutation-full-scheduled.yml).
THE LAW: a tier goes RED only when one of its pinned kernels measures more than one kill
below its pin (denominator unchanged); equal or higher AUTO-TIGHTENS (upward-in-quality
only). Absolute break floors (money-math 60 %, peripheral 70 %) stay ADVISORY text in the
scan output — this baseline, not the floors, decides the nightly verdict. A red that never
changes is not a signal (research/RED-NOTIFICATIONS-PATTERNS-2026-09-11.md §1 P3 / §2 F4).

WRITER DISCIPLINE (same as every *-baseline.json in this directory): only the scan writes
it, and only upward-in-quality — the nightly prints the tightened JSON as a proposal and
uploads it as the mutation-tier-baseline-update artifact; landing the proposal is a commit.
Deleting or corrupting this file REDS the ratchet step (named MISSING-FILE / INVALID-JSON /
MISSING-KEY / NAN-KEY states, per scripts/ratchet-baseline.mjs RATCHET-BASELINE-LOADER-1).
A pinned kernel that measured at seed but hard-fails later REDs (MEASUREMENT-LOST — SO
#34c at the ratchet boundary: you cannot silently lose a measurement). Kernels unpinned
here (never measurable at seed, e.g. stryker-produced-no-report failures, or not yet
reached by a complete shard pass) are ADVISORY until first measured; the first tighten
pins them. Kernel edits (denominator change) re-pin at current values in the proposal.

pins are [killed, total] per tier: mm = money-math, pe = peripheral; run = the workflow
run id whose scan last measured this kernel.
